issue.subject: QA: derive Test Scenarios and Test Cases and the AC to Test Scenario to Test Case traceability
issue.description:
**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

Follow the org QA standards (QA-Artifacts-and-Traceability-Standard and QA-Test-Case-Standard in https://git.frontiir.net/oss-dev/dev-workflow-tools/-/tree/main/sources).

IDs: RT-NOC-AUTO-AC<NN> (already on the Stories), RT-NOC-AUTO-TS<NN>, RT-NOC-AUTO-TC<NNN>. Test Scenarios go in the QA test plan on Wiki.js; Test Cases in a Google Sheet.

Suggested order: Stories S1 and S2 first (walking skeleton), then S4 and S9, then the rest.

QA also reviews each AC for testability as written (flag in particular AC42, AC43, AC49 and AC51 where wording depends on open decisions (AC11 is now defined; AC30, AC31 and AC42 were reworded on 2026-11-19)). The existing build is validated as a candidate against agreed ACs, not after a rewrite.

**Done when:** each AC has at least one Test Scenario, each scenario has Test Cases, and the traceability matrix is complete and linked from the Epic.
